findings.title: ui-catalog-product-detail--875c4-ify-cart-quantity-and-total-chromium
findings.summary: The test asserted a cart total or quantity of 2000, but the application calculated or displayed 1500, indicating a potential logic defect in the cart calculation.
findings.recommendedAction: Investigate the product's pricing logic or cart calculation service on the backend/frontend to ensure quantity increases correctly update the total to 2000.
